ctx.x: Marilyn Hammond who was just a darling, she was just a darling girl. And so Marilyn said, 'Oh, yes, Mr. Dexter's waiting to hear from you, Miss Lutcher.' I said, 'Well, would you give him my number and tell him to call.' And she said, 'Well, he will call you as soon as he gets in.' So sure enough, he did call me and he and I chatted and he told me he wanted me to come up, you know. He said, 'Well, I'd love for you to come up to the office here. I'd like to talk with you.'
